Date February 3, 1937.
Subject Yen Hei-Gaku, Korean radical.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.
With reference to my previous report dated January 13,
1937, concerning Yen Hei-Gaku(延秉學), a Korean radical,
I have to state that this individual, who has been detained
in the local Japanese Consulate pending investigation since
his arrest on January 7, 1937, was escorted to Korea by members
of the Japanese Consular Police on board the s.s. "Heian Maru"
to be handed over to the Korean Authorities. The vessel
left here on February 3, 1937.
Particulars recorded.
Kuh 4/2.

Date 25 / 1 / 37

January 25, 1937.

MAINICHI

BRITON USES ABUSIVE LANGUAGE TOWARDS JAPANESE
MARINE

Insults of foreigners towards
Japanese marines continue to occur, whilst the last
incident which took place at the corner of Ninghong
and Miller Roads has not yet been settled.
At 6.30 p.m. January 24 an
inebriated British subject spoke to a Japanese marine
who was on duty on Range Road, but the latter did not
interfere with him. The British subject, however, did
not leave the place and said in Japanese to the marine
"Bakayaro" (damn fool). The marine with the assistance
of a member of the S.M.P. first took the man to the
Japanese Naval Landing Party Sub-Station on Chapoo Road;
later he was sent to Hongkew Station where is now under-
going cross examination; the police, however, are faced
with difficulties because the prisoner was very drunk.
The authorities will punish him severely.

KOREAN REVOLUTIONIST TO BE ESCORTED TO KOREA

A Korean revolutionary named
Yen Byung Hak who was recently arrested in the French
Concession by the Japanese Consular Police will be
escorted to Korea on the s.s. "Hai An Maru" on January 31.

ISIS THEATRE TO DEMAND COMPENSATION FROM ITALIAN
AUTHORITIES

The Isis Theatre was recently
exhibiting a film of the Italian expedition in Abyssinia,
but it was suppressed by the Chinese authorities following
a complaint lodged by the local Italian Consular authorities.
The management of the Theatre in question, with the support
of the local Soviet authorities, presented a demand to
the Italian authorities requesting a satisfactory settlement
regarding the suppression of the film or compensation for
losses sustained because there was no real reason to
prohibit the screening of the picture which was approved
by the Censor of the Nanking Government. The Italian
authorities are reported to have stated that the film
was not a true story of the Italian expedition but contained
false "shots" which injured Italian interests. It is
believed that the Nanking Government Censor is being
criticised for passing the film without giving due
consideration to international susceptibilities.

日期 1937年1月25日

1937年1月25日。

《每日新闻》

英国人对日本海军陆战队员使用辱骂性语言

外国人侮辱日本海军陆战队员的事件仍时有发生，而此前在宁虹路（Ninghong Road）与米勒路（Miller Road）拐角处发生的最新事件尚未解决。
1月24日下午6时30分，一名醉酒的英国臣民对一名在兰路（Range Road）执勤的日本海军陆战队员说话，但后者并未与其纠缠。然而，该英国人并未离开现场，并用日语对该陆战队员说“Bakayaro”（混蛋/蠢货）。在该名陆战队员和一名工部局警务处警员的协助下，首先将该男子带至乍浦路日本海军陆战队分驻所；随后他被送往虹口巡捕房，目前正接受交叉讯问；然而，警方因囚犯醉酒严重而面临困难。当局将对其予以严惩。

朝鲜革命者将被护送至朝鲜

一名名为延秉昊（Yen Byung Hak）的朝鲜革命者，近期在法租界被日本领事警察逮捕，将于1月31日由“海安丸”号轮船护送至朝鲜。

伊西斯剧院要求意大利当局赔偿

伊西斯剧院（Isis Theatre）近期放映了一部关于意大利远征阿比西尼亚的影片，但在当地意大利领事当局提出投诉后，被中国当局禁映。该剧院管理层在当地苏维埃当局的支持下，向意大利当局提出要求，就禁映该片或赔偿损失寻求令人满意的解决方案，理由是禁止放映这部经南京政府审查官批准的影片并无正当理由。据报道，意大利当局表示，该影片并非意大利远征的真实记录，而是包含损害意大利利益的虚假“镜头”。据悉，南京政府审查官因未充分考虑国际敏感性便通过该片而受到批评。

January 12, 1937. Morning Translation.
Date 12. 1. 37

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

KOREAN INDEPENDENT PARTY LEADER ARRESTED

At 4 a.m. January 7, Sub-Inspector Fujii, Interpreter Hashizume and three other officers of the local Japanese Consular Police applied to the French Police for assistance to arrest one Yeu Byung Hak (延東学), leader of the Korean Independent Party, who was reported to be staying in the Bing An Lodging House (平安旅館), Rue Chu Pao San, French Concession. With the assistance of the French Police, the wanted man was arrested at 7 a.m. the same day in Room No.148 of the lodging house.

According to information released by the Japanese authorities, Yeu Byung Hak is the leader of the Korean Independent Party and was one of the ring-leaders of the Korean Independence Movement which broke out on March 1, 1919. Later, he proceeded to Manchuria where he remained several years after which he went to Nanking. In March, 1933, he organized the Korean Revolutionary Party and in July, 1934, he was appointed an executive member of the New Korean Independent Party. He is also connected with the Racial Revolutionary Party and the Kuomintang. He came to Shanghai at the end of 1936 and his presence here became known to the Japanese authorities through his canvassing for subscriptions towards an Independence Fund.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

ATTEMPTED ESCAPE OF A RUSSIAN PRISONER FROM THE SHANGHAI SECOND SPECIAL DISTRICT GAOL

At about 10 a.m. yesterday, a Russian inmate of the Shanghai Second Special District Gaol on Rue Massenet created a disturbance over the quality of the bread. A warder investigated. The Russian managed to leave his cell and attempted to escape but was re-captured. He was ordered by the Governor of the Gaol to be handed over to the French Police to be dealt with.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

JAPANESE AEROPLANES APPEAR OVER CHINESE TERRITORY

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has lodged a protest with the Japanese authorities over the flying of Japanese aeroplanes over Chinese territory.
A member of the Japanese Embassy, in a verbal reply, stated that the matter concerned the Japanese military office.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Chengchow telegram):

JAPANESE RONINS IN CHENGCHOW

On January 11, the Japanese Consul in Chengchow called on General Shang Chen, Chairman of the Honan Provincial Government, and tendered an apology over the action of Japanese ronins in Chengchow in plotting against a disturbance of the peace in that province.

1937年1月12日。晨间译稿。
日期 1937年1月12日

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

朝鲜独立党领袖被捕

1月7日凌晨4时，日本驻沪领事警察副巡官藤井、翻译桥爪及另外三名警官向法国警察申请协助，逮捕据报居住在法租界朱葆三路平安旅馆的朝鲜独立党领袖延东学（Yeu Byung Hak）。在法国警察的协助下，通缉犯于同日早上7时在该旅馆148号房间被捕。

根据日本当局发布的信息，延东学是朝鲜独立党领袖，也是1919年3月1日爆发的朝鲜独立运动的头目之一。此后他前往满洲，在那里停留数年后去了南京。1933年3月，他组织了朝鲜革命党，1934年7月，他被任命为新朝鲜独立党的执行委员。他还与种族革命党和国民党有联系。他于1936年底来到上海，因其在此募捐独立基金，其行踪被日本当局获悉。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

俄国囚犯企图从上海第二特区监狱越狱

昨日上午10时许，马思南路上海第二特区监狱的一名俄国囚犯因面包质量问题制造骚乱。一名看守进行调查。该俄国人设法离开牢房并企图逃跑，但被重新抓获。监狱长命令将其移交给法国警察处理。

《新晚报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

日本飞机出现在中国领空

外交部就日本飞机飞越中国领空一事向日本当局提出抗议。
日本大使馆一名成员在口头答复中表示，此事涉及日本军方。

《新晚报》及其他本地报纸（郑州电）：

郑州的日本浪人

1月11日，日本驻郑州领事拜访了河南省政府主席商震将军，就日本浪人在郑州策划扰乱该省治安的行为表示歉意。

Date... January 18, 1937.
Subject...... Arrest in the French Concession of a Korean Radical named
Yen Hei Gaku.
Made by...... D. S.. Kamashita................ Forwarded by
Acting on information received, a party of the local
Japanese Consular Police in conjunction with the French Police
conducted a raid at room No. 148, Ping An Hotel(平安旅社),
Avenue Edward VII, at 7 a.m. January 7, 1937, when a Korean
radical named Yen Hei-Gaku(延豪學), alias Yen Den-Mei(延田明),
alias Yen Hei-Ko(延豪昊), alias Yen Hei-Shun(延豪俊), was
arrested and a number of documents were seized. The Korean
is at present detained at the Japanese Consulate.
Yen was born in Chusai-Hokudo, Korea, in 1894. He was
involved in the "Banzai Riot", which took place in Korea on
March 1, 1919, but though pursued by police he succeeded in
escaping to Manchuria. After having travelled considerably in
Manchuria, he arrived in Nanking and joined the Korean Provisional
Government which was established in Shanghai in 1919. In March,
1933, Yen together with his colleagues organized a radical
organization known as the Korean Revolutionary Party in Nanking.
In the following year he joined the New Korean Independence
Party and was appointed as a member of the executive committee.
It is stated that Yen arrived in Shanghai from Nanking
on December 12, 1936, with the object of making contact with
a certain group, and that whilst residing here he sent several
threatening letters to local Korean residents demanding funds.
D.C.(G)
D. S. Kamashita
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch

主题...... 在法租界逮捕一名名为延豪學（Yen Hei Gaku）的朝鲜激进分子。
制作人...... D. S.. Kamashita................ 转呈人
根据所获情报，1937年1月7日上午7时，日本驻沪领事警察会同法国警察，在爱多亚路平安旅社148号房间进行突击搜查，逮捕了一名名为延豪學（Yen Hei-Gaku），别名延田明（Yen Den-Mei），别名延豪昊（Yen Hei-Ko），别名延豪俊（Yen Hei-Shun）的朝鲜激进分子，并查获若干文件。该朝鲜人目前被羁押于日本领事馆。
延氏于1894年出生于朝鲜忠清北道（Chusai-Hokudo）。他参与了1919年3月1日在朝鲜发生的“万岁暴动”，尽管遭到警方追捕，他成功逃往满洲。在满洲广泛游历后，他抵达南京，加入了1919年在上海成立的朝鲜临时政府。1933年3月，延氏与其同事在南京组织了一个名为朝鲜革命党的激进组织。次年，他加入新朝鲜独立党，并被任命为执行委员会委员。
据悉，延氏于1936年12月12日从南京抵达上海，目的是与某团体取得联系，且在此期间，他曾向当地朝鲜居民发送多封恐吓信索要资金。
D.C.(G)
D. S. Kamashita
副督察
特别科副总监
